title: situation.minnesota_first_remuster.title

gate.none: Voluntary military re-enlistment and service credit only; no policy concerning slavery, civilians, security, protected populations or an institution whose conduct requires a gate placement.

citations.at: p.17: May 4 suggestion, May 10 officer tender, voluntary May 11 remuster, original April 29 service credit, replacements for men declining. Retrospective regimental history. [I] A qualifying surviving one-regiment levy retains its existing model muster credit and aggregate men. No individual consent fraction, replacement count, new regiment or forced April 29 muster is invented.

namedOnly: The regiment's voluntary remuster is reported; no individual's words or decision are attributed.
